scope: WooCommerce HPOS MySQL large-store profiling under load

workload_descriptions.catalog-read: Product page, shop, and catalog search requests only.
workload_descriptions.storefront-mixed: Catalog reads, add-to-cart, and guest checkout writes.
workload_descriptions.admin-orders: Mostly wp-admin HPOS order list/search/edit requests with some live checkouts.
workload_descriptions.checkout-heavy: Mostly guest checkout/order creation, with some cart and admin reads.

notes: This is a local macOS diagnostic. Server and load generator share one VM.
No full-page cache or persistent object cache was enabled.
The fixture is not restored between cells to avoid storing a second 5GB copy; write volume is small relative to the fixture size.
